def simulate_snake(board_size, snake, food, moves):
    """
    Simulate snake game movement based on given moves.

    Args:
        board_size: Tuple (width, height)
        snake: List of (x, y) tuples, head first
        food: List of (x, y) tuples, only first is active
        moves: List of strings "UP", "DOWN", "LEFT", "RIGHT"

    Returns:
        Tuple (final_snake, alive, food_eaten)
    """
    width, height = board_size
    
    # Handle edge case of empty snake
    if not snake or len(snake) == 0:
        return ([], False, 0)
    
    head = snake[0]
    body = list(snake)  # Work on a copy
    all_food = [f[:] for f in food] if food else []  # Deep copy
    active_food_idx = 0 if all_food else -1
    
    food_eaten_count = 0
    alive = True
    current_direction = None  # Stores "UP", "DOWN", etc.
    
    dx_map = {
        "UP": (0, -1),
        "DOWN": (0, 1),
        "LEFT": (-1, 0),
        "RIGHT": (1, 0)
    }
    opposite_map = {"UP": "DOWN", "DOWN": "UP", "LEFT": "RIGHT", "RIGHT": "LEFT"}
    
    for move in moves:
        if not alive:
            break
        
        # Determine direction, do not reverse current movement
        dx, dy = 0, 0
        
        # If no current direction or not reversing, apply new direction
        if current_direction is None or move != opposite_map.get(current_direction):
            dx, dy = dx_map[move]
            current_direction = move
        
        # Calculate new head position
        new_head = (head[0] + dx, head[1] + dy)
        
        # Check boundary collision
        if not (0 <= new_head[0] < width and 0 <= new_head[1] < height):
            alive = False
            break
        
        # Determine if we eat food
        will_grow = False
        if all_food and active_food_idx >= 0:
            if new_head == all_food[active_food_idx]:
                will_grow = True
                active_food_idx += 1
                food_eaten_count += 1
        
        # Check self-collision (skip tail if not growing)
        collision = False
        for i in range(len(body)):
            # Skip tail cell if snake won't grow this move (it will move away)
            if not will_grow and i == len(body) - 1:
                continue
            if new_head == body[i]:
                collision = True
                break
        
        if collision:
            alive = False
            break
        
        # Update snake position
        if will_grow:
            # Snake grows, keep tail at end
            new_snake = [new_head] + list(body)
        else:
            # Normal movement, remove tail
            body_for_update = body[:-1]  # Remove last segment (tail)
            new_snake = [new_head] + body_for_update
        
        body = new_snake
    
    return (body, alive, food_eaten_count)
